70:     res.status(401).json({ error: 'missing authorization header' });
71:     return;

74:     const token = auth.split(' ')[1];
75:     const payload = jwt.verify(token, SECRET_KEY) as { user_id: number };
76:     const user = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?').get(payload.user_id) as User | undefined;
77:     if (!user) {
78:       res.status(401).json({ error: 'invalid token' });

part.text:
Done. Added a Handlebars template engine with layout and partial support.

- `src/template.ts` — new engine: page templates (frontmatter `template`, default `default`), layouts with `{{{body}}}` (frontmatter `layout`, default `default`), partials registered from `partials/` (header/footer/nav), built-in fallbacks matching the old output.
- `src/markdown.ts` — parses `template`/`layout` from frontmatter.
- `src/build.ts` — `buildSite` uses templates when the template dir exists, else the legacy `renderPageHtml` path (existing functionality preserved).
- `src/cli.ts` — new `-t, --templates <dir>` option.
- `templates/`, `templates/layouts/`, `templates/partials/` — example structure.
- Added `handlebars` to deps; updated `index.ts` exports.
- New `src/__tests__/template.test.ts` (17 tests) plus CLI tests for the templates option.
